cd /workspace
echo "=== all backend ports listening ==="
/workspace/.venv/bin/python -c "
import socket
ports=[18000,18001,18002,18003,18005,18006,18007,18008,18009,18010,18011,18012,18013,18014,18015,18016,18021,18022]
for port in ports:
    s=socket.socket(); s.settimeout(1.2)
    try:
        s.connect(('127.0.0.1',port)); st='OPEN'
    except Exception:
        st='CLOSED'
    s.close()
    print(port, st)
"
